description: Before putting a product found by Rabbit’s search into the client’s Shopify store, at the price they choose: what their card pays on each sale (or the list of variants to pick from). Puts nothing online. Rabbit suggests no price, and refuses a product whose sale would not cover its costs well enough.

prix_de_vente_eur.description: The selling price the client chooses. Without it, the tool has you ask for it.

produit.description: The `produit` reference returned by a search (starts with “p”).

variante.description: The variant number, in the list the tool returned.

name: store_preview
title: Preview before the store
